effect_description_eng:
When effects trash this card from the security stack, activate its [Security] effects.
[Main] 1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -6000 DP for the turn. Then, add your top security card to the hand and place this card as the top security card.
security_effect_description_eng: [Security] Place 1 of your opponent's Digimon with the lowest DP as their top security card.
